answer: To check an investment adviser’s registration and disclosures, use the free Check Out Your Investment Professional search tool on Investor.gov. It provides registration-status information and information that SEC- and state-registered advisers are required to provide about their businesses and investment advisory representatives. To find out which regulator has primary responsibility for an adviser, you can also contact the adviser directly.
